subject.title: fix(voice-call): persist assistant transcript on call.speaking events

question: Should this PR be narrowed to the voice-call transcript fix before any merge, or should the boot-run session and memory-classification changes be reviewed as part of this branch?
rationale: The voice transcript fix is bounded, but the same branch changes boot prompt handling, session-store classification, memory ingestion, and reaper behavior with security and session-state implications that automation should not decide silently.

options.title: Narrow to the voice fix
options.body: Require this branch or a replacement PR to preserve current boot safeguards, remove the boot/session side work, fix duplicate transcript paths, and provide redacted live call proof.

options.title: Review the broader branch
options.body: Keep boot-run session work in scope, but require explicit maintainer security/session-state review and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Pause until proof exists
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until the contributor or maintainer provides inspectable live proof and decides the scope split.

recommendation.title: Narrow to the voice fix
recommendation.body: Require this branch or a replacement PR to preserve current boot safeguards, remove the boot/session side work, fix duplicate transcript paths, and provide redacted live call proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is currently assigned to steipete and history shows repeated recent work on the voice-call and Google realtime surfaces.
